name: fierce
summary: A DNS reconnaissance tool for locating non-contiguous IP space.
highlights: --connect — attempt HTTP connection to non-RFC 1918 hosts
--wide — scan entire class c of discovered records
--traverse — scan NUMBER IPs before and after discovered records. This respects Class C boundaries and
--range — scan an internal IP range, use cidr notation
--subdomain-file — use subdomains specified in this file (one per line)
--dns-file — use dns servers specified in this file for reverse lookups (one per line)

flags.name: --help
flags.description: show this help message and exit

flags.name: --connect
flags.description: attempt HTTP connection to non-RFC 1918 hosts

flags.name: --wide
flags.description: scan entire class c of discovered records

flags.name: --traverse
flags.description: scan NUMBER IPs before and after discovered records. This respects Class C boundaries and won't enter adjacent subnets.

flags.name: --range
flags.description: scan an internal IP range, use cidr notation

flags.name: --subdomain-file
flags.description: use subdomains specified in this file (one per line)

flags.name: --dns-file
flags.description: use dns servers specified in this file for reverse lookups (one per line)
